newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Ghana president visits Nigerian ruler in Abuja.
newsitem.headline: Ghana president visits Nigerian ruler in Abuja.

text.p: Ghana's recently re-elected President Jerry Rawlings arrived in the Nigerian capital Abuja on Wednesday for talks with military ruler General Sani Abacha, officials said.
It is Rawlings first trip abroad since winning the Ghanaian poll 10 days ago to secure a second term as president.
Nigerian officials said the two West African leaders would discuss a range of issues including the peace process brokered in Liberia by the Economic Community of West African States.
Rawlings, who has excellent relations with Abacha, is expected to return to Accra later in the day.
Officials said Abacha would congratulate Rawlings on his election victory.
Rawlings, a former airforce officer seized power like Abacha before turning to democracy and contesting elections for a popular mandate.
Abacha, who has set elections for 1998 to restore democracy in Nigeria, is widely expected by the opposition to stand in the poll and transform himself into an elected president.
